examples.title: Attempts on a list row
examples.description: One segment per allowed attempt, filled for the attempts made, neutral in every state. It sits beside its count on a row's second line; the whole bar is one image named "2 of 5 attempts".
examples.code: Tool runner · 2 of 5 Assistant · 5 of 5 Assistant · 1 of 1

examples.title: Accent bar that fills its container
examples.description: With tone accent and layout block the bar is a progress cue in its own right, as in the reconnecting dialog's "Attempt 3 of 8". Name it with label so the count is spoken.
examples.code: Trying again in 4 s. Attempt 3 of 8.

examples.title: A goal with three of five attempts used
examples.description: On a goal row the bar sits beside its count, "3 of 5", in the same neutral colours in light and dark; running out of attempts never turns it red.
examples.code: Triage the refund queue · 3 of 5 Reconcile the ledger · 5 of 5
